task.description: Implement the ISS-106 webhook_deliveries outbox formalization migration exactly per src/design/iss-106-webhook-outbox.md. Create migrations/084_iss106_webhook_deliveries_outbox.sql (use the next free migration number — verify by listing migrations/; design references 084). The migration must: (1) ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; (2) backfill attempt from attempt_count; (3) remap legacy status values (pending->PENDING, success->DELIVERED, failed->FAILED, exhausted->FAILED) BEFORE adding the CHECK; (4) DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS then ADD CONSTRAINT webhook_deliveries_status_check CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','DELIVERED','FAILED','RETRYING')); (5) CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_wd_status_next_attempt(status, next_attempt_at) — do not duplicate. Additive only, idempotent, unqualified table names, applies to every tenant schema. NO DROP TABLE/DROP COLUMN. Do NOT modify dispatcher/engine Zig (that is ISS-205). Then run zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate — all must exit 0. Run zig build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error set' and ensure no output. Commit and push to the feature branch.
acceptance_criteria: Migration is additive, idempotent, unqualified names; no DROP TABLE/DROP COLUMN
status remap runs before the CHECK; CHECK domain is exactly (PENDING,DELIVERED,FAILED,RETRYING)
attempt column added and backfilled from attempt_count
index (status,next_attempt_at) reconciled via IF NOT EXISTS, not duplicated
zig build exits 0 with no 'error set' output
zig build migrate exits 0 and is idempotent on re-run
